data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 1m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2019. In 2018 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 1m. The reserve release was due to the Property and PCR accounts partially offset by deterioration in the Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 amounted to GBP 348.0m. Using the gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (<=2017) show net adverse development of approximately GBP 30.3m (c.8.7% of opening gross claims), indicating a gross prior-year strengthening. The managing agent narrative reports a small net release of GBP 1m (net of reinsurance) driven by favourable development in Property and PCR partially offset by deterioration in Professional Liability, Financial Institutions and Accident & Health. The gross/net divergence reflects reinsurance recoveries and the difference between gross triangle movements and the net movement disclosed in narrative.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 37-38) because the narrative reports only a NET prior-year release of GBP 1m. The triangle gives a gross PYD of +GBP 30.341m (strengthening). The Technical Provisions reconciliation shows overall gross movements during the year but that line includes current year movements and was not used per instructions. A subsequent event (RITC effective 1 Jan 2020) transfers large gross/net technical provisions (gross GBP 184.6m, net GBP 110.8m) and may affect comparability; this transaction is after year-end. Some class mappings (e.g. 'PCR') do not map exactly to the provided standard LOB list; LOB movement amounts were not quantified in the report and are therefore null.
